source_clause: C5.) Temperature ranges: LO, 60-84, HI (English), LO, 16-28, HI (Metric). This status is relayed from the CCM. Temperature will display the current degree value that the user has set it to for ATC systems, when at the Highest possible position display HI when at the lowest display LO instead of a degree value. The status is indicated on TS climate screen and in status bar. When the user sets the climate system temperature ranges to Metric the readout switches to half degree increments. Show pop-up when status is changed via hard control and currently shown screen is not climate screen. (when sync'd, do not show slider pop-up on passenger side when adjusting driver slider). The temperature within the temp slider, status bar, temp slider popup, and temp popup will reflect this change in temperature increments.
reasoning: 驗證目標：2.6（C5）定出溫度之範圍與顯示（度數／HI／LO）、公制之半度增量、非 climate screen 時之 popup，以及四個呈現位置之一致性，五個 037 leaf 逐一對應，一葉一 TC（§8.2.1）。關鍵情境條件：可觀察量皆落於 TS climate screen、狀態列與溫度 popup，依 **R-C34** 對四個介面型軸逐一提問 —— 第十三軸（3 旋鈕 ICS）與 EMEA ICS 皆移除該介面，故全數補排除式 PC；第九軸移除之 head unit comfort section 不含 climate screen 與狀態列，第十二軸移除之 tabs 本節不觀察，二者不補並具名於此。-01 另取第一軸 ATC，其第一問由「Temperature will display the current degree value that the user has set it to for ATC systems」明文對應。為什麼這樣切：五者之失效互相獨立（度數正確而 HI／LO 錯、公制切換正確而 popup 不出），且分屬不同觀察位置。刻意略過：條文之溫度區間（60-84／16-28）為 CCM 轉達之狀態，本節未定義其邊界行為，故 -02 以條文自身之詞「highest possible position」「lowest」判定而不寫入數值（R-C22）。

tcs.tc_title: Temperature shows on the climate screen and the status bar
tcs.test_item: For ATC systems, the temperature shall display the current degree value that the user has set it to, indicated on the TS climate screen and in the status bar
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-verbatim] The climate system is ATC (2.6)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the climate screen
2. Set the temperature to a degree value within the range
3. Read the temperature in the status bar
tcs.expected_result:
1. The climate screen shows the current temperature
2. The climate screen shows the degree value that was set
3. The status bar shows the same degree value
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

emea_ics_review.ch16_sentence: ICE5「Temperature will display the current degree value the user has set it to for ATC systems」＋「The status is indicated on TS climate screen and in status bar」

tcs.tc_title: HI and LO replace the degree value at the extremes
tcs.test_item: When at the highest possible position the system shall display HI, and when at the lowest it shall display LO, instead of a degree value
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-verbatim] The climate system is ATC (2.6)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Set the temperature to the highest possible position
2. Set the temperature to the lowest position
tcs.expected_result:
1. The climate screen shows HI instead of a degree value
2. The climate screen shows LO instead of a degree value
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)

emea_ics_review.ch16_sentence: ICE5「when at the Highest possible position display HI when at the lowest display LO instead of a degree value」

tcs.pre_conditions:

tcs.tc_title: Slider status bar and pop-ups follow the increment change
